description: The Republic of Ireland's Health Service Executive (HSE) has approved UKALL14 phase 2 standard induction therapy as a treatment option for the induction of remission in newly diagnosed, previously untreated adult patients with acute lymphoblastic leukaemia (ALL) (aged 25-65 years) treated on UKALL14-protocol following phase 1 induction therapy. The treatment regimen notes that rituximab is to be included in CD20 positive patients (in general >20% positivity), and that the regimen may sometimes be used in patients aged >= 19 years with Philadelphia chromosome positive acute lymphoblastic leukaemia. Imatinib is included for Philadelphia chromosome positive patients.
